newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIAN ROSGOSSTRAKH COURT HEARING DELAYED AUG 28.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIAN ROSGOSSTRAKH COURT HEARING DELAYED AUG 28.

text.p: The Moscow Arbitration Court has postponed to August 28 a hearing of a suit against the State Property Committee over the suspension of the privatisation of insurer Rosgosstrakh, Rosgosstrakh said on Wednesday.
"There was a court sitting and it was postponed until August 28," Chief Executive Vladislav Reznik told Reuters.
The suit was filed by RGS-Trust, a firm representing Rosgosstrakh management, last month, after the State Property Committee, Russia's privatisation ministry, suspended privatisation of the company.
Under Rosgosstrakh's privatisation scheme, employees bought 20 percent of shares and RGS-Trust has a priority right to buy 30 percent. The remaining 50 percent was to be put up for auction this year.
Reznik said the reason for the postponement was the court's wish to question the Russian Federal Property Fund, the State Property Committee's agent in sales, and Rosgosstrakh.
